title: Team possession: skaters or players carry one puck or ball, pass and shoot at two goals
summary: Two teams of a few walkers or skaters on a bounded rink; whoever has the puck inside his reach carries it on his stick, passes to a mate or shoots; a puck inside a goal volume is a point; periods and a score decide. The worked example is the house game hockey (engine/packs/hockey). Covers ice hockey, street hockey, five-a-side football, a team ball game with carriers and passes.
applies_when: two teams of several players each, the player controls one of them and the others are run by the AI
players carry the ball or puck themselves, pass it to mates and shoot it at the other team's goal
a point is the ball or puck inside a goal; the match ends by a score or by periods on a clock
not_when: hockey or another game on a rink with a puck: card.rink_core (a cartridge on the rink core, thirdjam's match); since 24 Nov this card's old hockey is the hand-built route only
one piece per side on a rail or in its own half returning the ball by contact (pong, air hockey): use card.two_sides_ball
no opponent team: targets to knock down use card.knock_down, a course against the clock card.timed_drive
a full simulation with goalies, offside or line changes (hockey shows none of them; see its README, known limits)

data_files.role: the play space as one tl.layout/1 file: the rink and the two goals
the dressing as a second tl.layout/1 file: stands, scoreboards, light masts, signs, flags, the entrance
the rules object TLRules is created from (sides, score, periods) plus skater, shot, carry (reach, pass speed) and camera numbers
what the AI skaters do: roles, reaction, how they chase, pass and shoot
one difficulty level of the opponents (reaction frames, speed share); pro and all-star beside it
one mode as data (roster, rules, rink); the other modes are files beside it

do: Decide possession by reach: a loose puck inside a player's ring is his on that frame; carry it with TLBall.hold and let it go with TLBall.release for a shot or a pass.
Put a goal volume in each net (TLBodies.trigger) and read the puck's position against it every live tick: a puck inside counts carried, released or lying there, not only on the enter event.
Keep the rule set, the levels and the modes as data files; the script reads them and only TLRules decides the score and the end.
Move the AI players with TLSteer (arrive, separate) from roles in data/ai.json; difficulty is their reaction and speed, not hidden help.
Name the player's check: one bot drives the human side's actions and fails when that side never touched the puck.
Read every difficulty figure through a hand (TLHand: perfect, sharp, regular, newcomer), never through a perfect bot alone.
dont: Do not let the human's AI mates take a loose puck he is as near to: they yield it to him (scripts/ai/brain.gd).
Do not hand the puck to anybody at a face-off: drop it between the two centre men outside both reaches.
Do not animate a hit by hand: the closing speed picks bump, stumble or knockdown (numbers in data/tuning.json hits) and TLBiped's own down, stumble and shove play it.
Do not tune the levels against the perfect hand: the ladder is read per hand (tl ladder).

Do not carry hockey into a ball game. From the house hockey a football or basketball game takes the bodies (TLBiped, how a body takes contact, stumbles and falls), possession by reach, the pass and the team AI (spacing, yielding to the human, pressing); NOT the stick, the puck, the one-timer, the boards and board bonus, the body check or the cross-check: those are hockey's own. The game's verbs, contact numbers and filmed moments are its own design's, and the Foreman judges it by them (the house game's other rows and moments are not missing).

bot.plays_by: the human side's own actions through a TLHand: it gets behind the puck on the far side from the other goal, dribbles toward the goal around the opponents and shoots when within range and lined up.
bot.wins_when: the match reached its result (the HUD reads WIN, LOSE or DRAW) and the bot's skater took the puck at least once; who won is a number in the result, the must-win verdict is a separate ladder cell.

acceptance: The bot plays a match to its result and takes the puck at least once, on seeds 1 to 20.
A player who does nothing never takes the puck and does not win the face-off.
A bot-only match ends with both sides scoring and nobody outside the rink.
Every mode file ends by its own rules inside its frame budget.
Lint reports 0 bypasses; the win share per level is quoted with the hand it was read through.

camera: A chase camera behind the player's skater (TLCameras.chase), so carrying, passing and shooting read from behind; the fixed arena view stays for captures (TLCameras.set_subject).
The camera must show the goal the player attacks; a view from 100 m up loses the puck and the player.
juice: A goal gets the horn, a cheer, a goal flash and confetti (TLVfx.burst, TLAudio.play), as the hockey fx script does.
Fast skating throws ice spray; a check that lands should shake the view a little (TLCameras.shake) and knock the skater down (TLBiped.down).
A shot needs weight: a short wind-up, a sound on release, a spray where the puck leaves the stick.
rivals: Opposing skaters play roles from data (chaser, defender, a goalie in the crease) and steer with TLSteer.arrive and TLSteer.separate; difficulty is their speed and reaction, read through a TLHand.
Give the other team a name and one habit the player can read: the chaser always goes for the carrier; the defender cheats toward the slot.
first_minute: The puck drops near the player's skater and one hint line names the three keys (move, pass, shoot); the first opponent is slow to arrive.
No goalie or a weak one in the first round, so the first shot can score.
stakes: Periods and a score on the HUD (TLHud.add_score, TLHud.add_clock); the end screen says WIN, LOSE or DRAW and by how much.
A ladder of difficulty levels (data) so a win unlocks a harder opponent.

variants.change: the kit's ball for the puck and ground_patch for the rink in data/venue.json; walkers instead of skaters in data/tuning.json; the same possession by reach.
